data.title: 埃列什基伽勒 · 冥界花嫁的誓约·「连死亡都拆不散的契约」
data.description: 【想象场景】【冥界大圣堂·婚礼日】连神都很少踏足的冥界深处，今天亮起了婚礼的烛光。埃列什基伽勒披着白纱站在圣堂中央，金发王冠与白纱相映，红瞳里的泪光胜过所有魂火——「冥界的女王结婚……连死神都会来观礼的吧。这份契约的效力是——直到永远。连死亡，都拆不散哦。」
data.action: 白纱立于圣堂烛光中，金冠白纱相映红瞳含泪微笑
data.camera: wide shot, environmental portrait, underworld chapel bride, candle glow, sacred mood
data.promptProse: Ereshkigal stands at the underworld cathedral's center with a small white bouquet held in both hands, relieved red eyes shining beneath her golden tiara and long veil. The opaque white wedding gown remains complete in the wide vertical view, distant columns framing the imagined vow. Candlelight warms the flowers and facing fabric folds; blue soul fires illuminate opposite veil edges and column bases, carrying the hall into layered darkness beyond her train.
